title: Concept: Yarn registry configured over cleartext
description: .yarnrc.yml declares an `npmRegistryServer` URL over cleartext, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: An artifact fetched over plain HTTP can be replaced in transit, so the bytes that install are not bound to what the author published. This rule reads an `npmRegistryServer` URL over cleartext.
